input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (full prompt in prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md)

goal: Get the four bowling seasons stuck 1 off the even lane split to 0 or prove them out of reach
notes: 3 of 4 seasons now at the bound (22x10, 22x21, 24x23) and stored in bowling-lane-table.mjs; 26x38 still 1 (kissat 2400 s, no answer). Key finding: writing the limit-1 count as pairwise AMO instead of a sequential counter takes 22x10 from no answer in 420 s to 1.5 s; limit-2 seasons fell to kissat404+totalizer (~21-23 min) and 22x21 to cadical153 with direct forbidden triples (~4 min). Cyclic families sigma(k)+c*r and sigma(k)+tau(r): none (22x10 UNSAT in the second). Limit-1 24x11, 26x12, 28x13: none in 900 s pairwise. Verification: node --test bowling.test.mjs 34 pass 0 fail (new test 22 teams 10 weeks atBound 22); offBound 0 re-checked in node for all three answers; eval/bowling-lane-near-check.mjs unchanged for the remaining rows; back-to-back repeats 22x21 20->13, 24x23 19->24 (balance first); check_posts ok; validate.py ok. run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator: ok, 997 tests, 250.7 s; site page checks ok.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
